claim: On September 29, 2023 the Amazon EKS documentation stated that the Amazon EKS integrations with AWS App Mesh remain for existing customers of App Mesh only.
question: Can new customers rely on the EKS integration with AWS App Mesh?

values.display: remain for existing customers of App Mesh only

note: App Mesh is not an in-scope service. The date 2026-09-30 for the end of support of App Mesh (FRESHNESS.md) is not stated by any AWS page in the corpus.
